node.title: Re: Read from STDIN and stay on same line
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You've seen how (relatively) long the code to read from the terminal without the newline is, and you've asked for how to do it without a special module, but why? [id://693828]...

Since I was just playing around with it the other day, here's a solution using [mod://IO::Prompter], nice and short - I've added the -num option so that it even validates the input for you and limits it to numbers.

use IO::Prompter; my $num = prompt("How much is A:", -num, -return=>" "); print "A=$num\n";
